name: Dyson Sphere Program
description: Build your factories together. Nebula shares one universe between players: the same planets, factories, belts, research and Dyson spheres, with everyone building at once.

setup.title: Dyson Sphere Program
setup.detail: Install Dyson Sphere Program from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, and the mod loader it needs, in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it and BepInEx, the loader it runs on, in the game's folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play to start Dyson Sphere Program.
In the main menu choose Multiplayer, then Host Game.
Share your address with your friends. The mod listens on port 8469 (TCP).
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play.
In the main menu choose Multiplayer, then Join Game.
Enter the host's address and port and connect: you arrive in the host's universe.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: Join by address. Both players need the same version of the mod and the same game version.

items.name: Same universe
items.detail: One universe for everyone: the same planets, resources and Dyson spheres.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and its loader in the game's folder and updates them when a new version is released.

items.name: Factories
items.detail: Buildings, belts, drones, stations and research are shared as they are made.

items.name: Players
items.detail: Positions, appearance and effects are shown to everyone, on planets and in space.

items.name: Combat
items.detail: Most of the combat is shared, a few features are still being worked on.
